name: Trello Connector
description: Read and operate on Trello: browse boards, lists and cards, read card details, checklists and comments, create and update cards, move them between lists and boards, manage labels, members and due dates, and comment -- across multiple Trello accounts.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List the connected Trello accounts and whether each credential pair still works.

refresh.description: Re-read account and board details from Trello instead of the cache
refresh.title: Refresh

return_schema.description: One connected Trello account (one key/token pair).
return_schema.title: TrelloAccount

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: List the Trello boards the connected accounts can reach, with their organization and whether they are closed.

refresh.description: Re-read the board list from Trello instead of the cache
refresh.title: Refresh

return_schema.description: One board reachable by a connected credential.
return_schema.title: TrelloBoard

tools.name: list_lists
tools.description: List the lists (columns) of a Trello board, in board order.

board.description: Board name, e.g. 'Client Work'. Omit when the credentials reach only one board.
board.title: Board

return_schema.description: One list (column) on a board.
return_schema.title: TrelloList

tools.name: list_cards
tools.description: List cards on a Trello board or in one of its lists, with due dates, members and labels.

board.description: Board name, e.g. 'Client Work'. Omit when the credentials reach only one board.
board.title: Board

list_name.description: Only cards in this list (column), e.g. 'Doing'. Omit for every card on the board.
list_name.title: List Name

return_schema.description: One Trello card, flattened for display.
return_schema.title: TrelloCard

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Read one Trello card in full: description, due date, members, labels, checklists and which list it sits in.

board.description: Board name, e.g. 'Client Work'. Omit when the credentials reach only one board.
board.title: Board

return_schema.description: One Trello card, flattened for display.
return_schema.title: TrelloCard

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: Read the comments on a Trello card, newest first.

board.description: Board name, e.g. 'Client Work'. Omit when the credentials reach only one board.
board.title: Board

card.description: Card whose comments to read (name or id)
card.title: Card

return_schema.description:
One comment on a card.

Trello has no comment resource: comments are ACTIONS of type `commentCard`,
so `id` here is an action id and cannot be used where a card id is expected.
return_schema.title: TrelloComment

tools.name: list_checklists
tools.description: List the checklists on a Trello card with their items and which are done.

board.description: Board name, e.g. 'Client Work'. Omit when the credentials reach only one board.
board.title: Board

card.description: Card whose checklists to read (name or id)
card.title: Card

return_schema.description: One checklist on a card, with its items flattened.
return_schema.title: TrelloChecklist

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List the labels defined on a Trello board -- their names and colours.

board.description: Board name, e.g. 'Client Work'. Omit when the credentials reach only one board.
board.title: Board

return_schema.description:
One label on a board.

`name` is often EMPTY: Trello's six default labels are colour-only, which is
why the colour is carried as a first-class field rather than a detail.
return_schema.title: TrelloLabel

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List the people on a Trello board, with their usernames.

board.description: Board name, e.g. 'Client Work'. Omit when the credentials reach only one board.
board.title: Board

return_schema.description: One person on a board.
return_schema.title: TrelloMember

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Trello for cards and boards by text.

params_schema.description:
Trello search is ACCOUNT-wide, not board-scoped.

Not BoardScoped on purpose: `/search` spans every board the token can see,
which is the point of a search. Restricting it would make it a worse
version of list_cards.

query.description: Text to search for in cards and boards
query.title: Query

partial.description: Match partial words too -- 'reno' finds 'renovation'. Trello's default is exact-word only.
partial.title: Partial

params_schema.title: SearchParams

return_schema.description: One search result -- a card, board or member.
return_schema.title: TrelloSearchHit

tools.name: check_access
tools.description: Report what this connector can currently reach in Trello, and explain anything missing.

board.description: Board name, e.g. 'Client Work'. Omit when the credentials reach only one board.
board.title: Board

return_schema.description:
What the connector can currently reach, and why anything is missing.

The field set mirrors what `check_access` actually reports. It was
originally written around a single board (list_count, can_write) while the
handler reported across ACCOUNTS -- and pydantic drops undeclared keyword
fields silently, so the report rendered blank with no error anywhere. Named
for the facts the handler really has.
return_schema.title: AccessReport

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Connect a Trello account by saving its API key and token, after checking the pair actually works.

params_schema.description:
The credentials the user pastes on the Connect screen.

Not BoardScoped: this is the one action that runs BEFORE any board is
known, so asking which board to act in would be circular. The boards are
discovered FROM the credentials.

TWO fields, not one, because Trello access is a PAIR -- the key identifies
the app, the token identifies the user, and neither works alone.

key.description: Trello API key -- 32 hex characters, from the API Key tab of your Power-Up at trello.com/apps/admin.
key.title: Key

token.description: Trello token -- generated with that key by clicking the 'Token' link beside it and allowing access.
token.title: Token

params_schema.title: ConnectAccountParams

return_schema.description: Outcome of connecting credentials -- what got connected, and what next.
return_schema.title: ConnectResult

secrets.name: trello_credentials
secrets.description: Trello API key and token -- one 'key:token' pair per line, one line per account. Generate the key at trello.com/apps/admin (Power-Up -> API Key), then click the 'Token' link beside it to authorise your own account. A token reaches every board its owner can see.
